# LearnPuppy

> A local learning harness: tutor, Knowledge Graph and spaced repetition.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://prathambhavsar.github.io/learnpuppy/docs/#/intro): What LearnPuppy is, what runs where, and which screens it has.
- [Install](https://prathambhavsar.github.io/learnpuppy/docs/#/install): Build from source today, or use the release installer once the repo is public.
- [Quickstart](https://prathambhavsar.github.io/learnpuppy/docs/#/quickstart): From a built binary to your first learning chat and first review.
- [Workspaces](https://prathambhavsar.github.io/learnpuppy/docs/#/workspaces): Isolated knowledge bases for separate subjects.
- [Learn](https://prathambhavsar.github.io/learnpuppy/docs/#/learn): Probe, plan, teach, practice. What each phase does and the question types.
- [Knowledge Graph](https://prathambhavsar.github.io/learnpuppy/docs/#/graph): The cross-session graph, how to explore it, and practice from a selection.
- [Review](https://prathambhavsar.github.io/learnpuppy/docs/#/review): FSRS spaced repetition, review sessions, the card browser and Digest.
- [Accounts](https://prathambhavsar.github.io/learnpuppy/docs/#/accounts): The CLI account pool, role slots and failover.
- [Security](https://prathambhavsar.github.io/learnpuppy/docs/#/security): The local-only model, and what it does not protect against.
- [CLI](https://prathambhavsar.github.io/learnpuppy/docs/#/cli): learnpuppy doctor, serve and migrate.
- [FAQ](https://prathambhavsar.github.io/learnpuppy/docs/#/faq): Status, what was verified, limits, and the home page screenshot.

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/PrathamBhavsar/learnpuppy)
